newsitem.title: USA: Physicians Clinical files for Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Physicians Clinical files for Chapter 11.

text.p: Physicians Clinical Laboratory Inc said Monday it has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in Los Angeles.
The company said in a statement the filing is to help its debt restructuring and the acquisition of the firm by an investor group.

Physicians Clinical said the investor group plans to make an immediate $9.8 million working capital cash infusion while an additional $5.0 million of capital will be made available when the restructuring is completed.
The restructuring is expected to take five to six months.
Under the proposed terms of the restructuring, the interests of existing stockholders and debenture holders would be significantly and substantially diluted and possibly eliminated, the company said.
Physicians Clinical is a full service clinical laboratory which employs about 1,200 people throughout California.
